decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud messaging launch at the center of the firm's strategic direction, a product that has survived this long likely meets aspiration levels or is protected by enough slack to keep developing.
It fits the push toward digital document workflows, and in a growing market management is more likely to keep refining and cross-selling it than to redeploy its resources now.
Although it is more legacy-oriented and less visible, it reuses established email and fax capabilities for regulated German customers, so it is risky but still not clearly below aspiration.
This close-to-core optimization feature likely consumes limited additional resources, so behavioral logic suggests keeping it unless its contribution falls clearly short of aspiration.
Multi-engine virus scanning remains a sensible complement to the core messaging platform, and absent strong evidence of underperformance the firm would usually retain it within the portfolio.
